articles.title: Softcat (LSE:SCT) Stock Faces FY Results Margin Squeeze
articles.summary: Softcat just released its full year 2026 numbers and the stock went into the announcement on the back foot, with the share price down over the past week and month. The headline is simple. Earnings per share for the second half were £0.43 on revenue of £1,137.6m, while trailing net profit margin now stands at 7.6% compared with 9.1% a year earlier. That margin squeeze is influencing sentiment. Short term price weakness appears less like panic and more like a response to profitability pressure,...
